title: 直驅永磁風力發電機
titleEn: Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generators
subcategoryTitleEn: Wind turbine components, foundations and grid connection
summary: 直驅風機把發電機的轉子直接接在葉輪上，省去齒輪箱；發電機因此必須在每分鐘十轉左右的低速下產生全部的扭矩，直徑達數公尺到十公尺，表面排滿釹鐵硼永久磁鐵。課程定量分析氣隙剪應力能產生的扭矩、輸出電的頻率、一台發電機所需的磁鐵量，以及只有幾公釐的氣隙對結構剛度的要求。
summaryEn: A direct-drive turbine couples the generator rotor straight to the wind rotor with no gearbox, so the generator must make all its torque at about ten revolutions a minute, metres to ten metres across with neodymium-iron-boron magnets covering its surface. The course quantifies torque from air-gap shear stress, frequency of its output, magnet needed for one machine, and what an air gap of a few millimetres demands of structural stiffness.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 沒有齒輪箱的發電機：氣隙剪應力與扭矩、極數與頻率、永久磁鐵的用量與氣隙公差
v30FocusEn: A generator with no gearbox: air-gap shear stress and torque, poles and frequency, magnet quantity and air-gap tolerance

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：直驅永磁風力發電機
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generators
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掃掠面積與比功率」與「葉尖速與轉速」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Swept area and specific power" and "Tip speed and rotor speed": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「掃掠面積與比功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Swept area and specific power" is correct?
options: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。
風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。
大型風機的葉片轉得很慢，所以葉尖的速度也很慢。
optionsEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared.
A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter.
The blades of a large turbine turn slowly, so the tips move slowly too.
quiz.explanation: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「掃掠面積與比功率」如何決定「直驅永磁風力發電機」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Swept area and specific power” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generators”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。額定功率除以掃掠面積稱為比功率：比功率低（大葉輪配小發電機）的風機在中低風速就接近滿載，容量因數高、出力平穩；比功率高的風機造價較低，但只有在強風場址才划算。現代離岸風機直徑超過 200 公尺，單機掃掠面積相當於數個足球場。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared. Rated power divided by swept area is specific power: a low value, a big rotor on a small generator, reaches full load at moderate wind and gives high capacity factor and steadier output, while a high value is cheaper but pays only at windy sites. Modern offshore rotors exceed 200 m, sweeping the area of several football pitches each. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：直驅發電機的額定轉速約為每分鐘 8 至 15 轉
steps.observationEn: Project file: Rated speed of a direct-drive generator is about 8 to 15 rpm
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「掃掠面積與比功率」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Swept area and specific power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掃掠面積與比功率
knowledge.text: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。額定功率除以掃掠面積稱為比功率：比功率低（大葉輪配小發電機）的風機在中低風速就接近滿載，容量因數高、出力平穩；比功率高的風機造價較低，但只有在強風場址才划算。現代離岸風機直徑超過 200 公尺，單機掃掠面積相當於數個足球場。
knowledge.textEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared. Rated power divided by swept area is specific power: a low value, a big rotor on a small generator, reaches full load at moderate wind and gives high capacity factor and steadier output, while a high value is cheaper but pays only at windy sites. Modern offshore rotors exceed 200 m, sweeping the area of several football pitches each.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 直驅發電機的額定轉速約為每分鐘 8 至 15 轉
knowledge.textEn: Rated speed of a direct-drive generator is about 8 to 15 rpm

quiz.question: 依「掃掠面積與比功率」的模型 P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)，額定功率與掃掠面積之比最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4) for "Swept area and specific power", which value is closest to the rated power per unit swept area?
options: 181 W/m²
362 W/m²
optionsEn: 181 W/m²
362 W/m²
quiz.explanation: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)；代入 Pr = 14 MW、D = 222 m，得 362 W/m²（額定功率與掃掠面積之比）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4); with Pr = 14 MW, D = 222 m the result is 362 W/m² (rated power per unit swept area). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掃掠面積與比功率」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Swept area and specific power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)；代入 Pr = 14 MW、D = 222 m，得 362 W/m²（額定功率與掃掠面積之比）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 D 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4); with Pr = 14 MW, D = 222 m the result is 362 W/m² (rated power per unit swept area). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise D by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 299 W/m²（-17.4%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 299 W/m² (-17.4%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 362 W/m²（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 D 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 362 W/m² (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in D with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)；代入 Pr = 14 MW、D = 222 m，得 362 W/m²（額定功率與掃掠面積之比）。
knowledge.textEn: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4); with Pr = 14 MW, D = 222 m the result is 362 W/m² (rated power per unit swept area).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 299 W/m²（-17.4%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 299 W/m² (-17.4%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掃掠面積與比功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Swept area and specific power"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
只要葉片設計得夠好，風機可以把風的能量百分之百轉成電。
由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With good enough blades a turbine can convert all the wind's energy into electricity.
Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power.
quiz.explanation: 由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「掃掠面積與比功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Swept area and specific power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：機型比較表要同時列出額定功率、葉輪直徑、比功率與場址風速分布下的預估年發電量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Model comparisons should list rated power, rotor diameter, specific power and estimated annual energy for the site wind distribution together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。
knowledge.textEn: Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 機型比較表要同時列出額定功率、葉輪直徑、比功率與場址風速分布下的預估年發電量。
knowledge.textEn: Model comparisons should list rated power, rotor diameter, specific power and estimated annual energy for the site wind distribution together.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61400-1 風力機設計要求。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61400-1 Wind energy generation systems – Design requirements. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「掃掠面積與比功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Swept area and specific power" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
大型風機的葉片轉得很慢，所以葉尖的速度也很慢。
optionsEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The blades of a large turbine turn slowly, so the tips move slowly too.
quiz.explanation: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掃掠面積與比功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Swept area and specific power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「直驅永磁風力發電機」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generators”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現代離岸風機直徑超過 200 公尺，單機掃掠面積相當於數個足球場。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern offshore rotors exceed 200 m, sweeping the area of several football pitches each.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 1993：首款量產的直驅風機問世（採電勵磁）
knowledge.textEn: 1993: The first series direct-drive turbine appeared, electrically excited

quiz.question: 關於「葉尖速與轉速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tip speed and rotor speed" is correct?
options: 大型風機的葉片轉得很慢，所以葉尖的速度也很慢。
發電機的功率只跟它的體積有關，跟形狀無關。
葉片越長，同樣的葉尖線速度對應的轉速越低。
optionsEn: The blades of a large turbine turn slowly, so the tips move slowly too.
A generator's power depends only on its volume, not its shape.
The longer the blade, the lower the rotor speed for a given tip speed.
quiz.explanation: 葉片越長，同樣的葉尖線速度對應的轉速越低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The longer the blade, the lower the rotor speed for a given tip speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 葉尖速與轉速：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Tip speed and rotor speed: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「葉尖速與轉速」如何決定「直驅永磁風力發電機」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tip speed and rotor speed” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generators”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 葉片越長，同樣的葉尖線速度對應的轉速越低。葉尖速受噪音、前緣沖蝕與離心負載限制，離岸風機通常在每秒 90 至 100 公尺左右，因此直徑兩百多公尺的葉輪每分鐘只轉七、八圈。低轉速意味著發電機要嘛做成直徑很大的多極直驅式，要嘛經齒輪箱增速；轉矩等於功率除以角速度，也隨葉輪加大而快速上升。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The longer the blade, the lower the rotor speed for a given tip speed. Tip speed is limited by noise, leading-edge erosion and centrifugal load, typically about 90–100 m/s offshore, so a rotor over two hundred metres across turns only seven or eight times a minute. Low speed means the generator is either a large-diameter multi-pole direct drive or is geared up; torque, power over angular speed, also rises rapidly with rotor size. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：大型直驅永磁發電機的直徑約 6 至 10 m
steps.observationEn: Project file: Large direct-drive permanent-magnet generators are about 6 to 10 m in diameter
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大型風機的葉片轉得很慢，所以葉尖的速度也很慢。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The blades of a large turbine turn slowly, so the tips move slowly too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「葉尖速與轉速」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Tip speed and rotor speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 葉尖速與轉速
knowledge.text: 葉片越長，同樣的葉尖線速度對應的轉速越低。葉尖速受噪音、前緣沖蝕與離心負載限制，離岸風機通常在每秒 90 至 100 公尺左右，因此直徑兩百多公尺的葉輪每分鐘只轉七、八圈。低轉速意味著發電機要嘛做成直徑很大的多極直驅式，要嘛經齒輪箱增速；轉矩等於功率除以角速度，也隨葉輪加大而快速上升。
knowledge.textEn: The longer the blade, the lower the rotor speed for a given tip speed. Tip speed is limited by noise, leading-edge erosion and centrifugal load, typically about 90–100 m/s offshore, so a rotor over two hundred metres across turns only seven or eight times a minute. Low speed means the generator is either a large-diameter multi-pole direct drive or is geared up; torque, power over angular speed, also rises rapidly with rotor size.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大型風機的葉片轉得很慢，所以葉尖的速度也很慢。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The blades of a large turbine turn slowly, so the tips move slowly too. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 大型直驅永磁發電機的直徑約 6 至 10 m
knowledge.textEn: Large direct-drive permanent-magnet generators are about 6 to 10 m in diameter

quiz.question: 依「葉尖速與轉速」的模型 n = 60·v_tip / (π·D)，葉尖速 v_tip 對應的葉輪轉速（葉尖速為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model n = 60·v_tip / (π·D) for "Tip speed and rotor speed", which value is closest to the rotor speed for tip speed v_tip (representative tip speed)?
options: 7.74 rpm
77.4 rpm
3.87 rpm
optionsEn: 7.74 rpm
77.4 rpm
3.87 rpm
quiz.explanation: n = 60·v_tip / (π·D)；代入 vt = 90 m/s、D = 222 m，得 7.74 rpm（葉尖速 v_tip 對應的葉輪轉速（葉尖速為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: n = 60·v_tip / (π·D); with vt = 90 m/s, D = 222 m the result is 7.74 rpm (rotor speed for tip speed v_tip (representative tip speed)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 葉尖速與轉速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tip speed and rotor speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「葉尖速與轉速」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Tip speed and rotor speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：n = 60·v_tip / (π·D)；代入 vt = 90 m/s、D = 222 m，得 7.74 rpm（葉尖速 v_tip 對應的葉輪轉速（葉尖速為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 D 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: n = 60·v_tip / (π·D); with vt = 90 m/s, D = 222 m the result is 7.74 rpm (rotor speed for tip speed v_tip (representative tip speed)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise D by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.04 rpm（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 7.04 rpm (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 7.74 rpm（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 D 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 7.74 rpm (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in D with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: n = 60·v_tip / (π·D)；代入 vt = 90 m/s、D = 222 m，得 7.74 rpm（葉尖速 v_tip 對應的葉輪轉速（葉尖速為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: n = 60·v_tip / (π·D); with vt = 90 m/s, D = 222 m the result is 7.74 rpm (rotor speed for tip speed v_tip (representative tip speed)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.04 rpm（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 7.04 rpm (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「葉尖速與轉速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tip speed and rotor speed"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以主軸編碼器量測轉速，並在額定運轉點核對轉速、功率與由此推得的主軸轉矩是否落在傳動鏈設計包絡內。
發電機的轉子和定子之間空隙大一點比較安全，沒有壞處。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Measure speed with the main-shaft encoder and check that speed, power and the implied main-shaft torque at rated operation lie within the drivetrain design envelope.
A larger gap between rotor and stator is safer and has no drawback.
quiz.explanation: 以主軸編碼器量測轉速，並在額定運轉點核對轉速、功率與由此推得的主軸轉矩是否落在傳動鏈設計包絡內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure speed with the main-shaft encoder and check that speed, power and the implied main-shaft torque at rated operation lie within the drivetrain design envelope. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 葉尖速與轉速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tip speed and rotor speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「葉尖速與轉速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tip speed and rotor speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以主軸編碼器量測轉速，並在額定運轉點核對轉速、功率與由此推得的主軸轉矩是否落在傳動鏈設計包絡內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure speed with the main-shaft encoder and check that speed, power and the implied main-shaft torque at rated operation lie within the drivetrain design envelope. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：前緣保護系統的選型要以場址降雨與葉尖速做沖蝕壽命評估，並把檢查與補修窗口排入年度維護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Select leading-edge protection from an erosion-life assessment using site rainfall and tip speed, and schedule inspection and repair windows in annual maintenance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：葉尖速過高時雨滴與冰晶撞擊使前緣塗層在數年內剝蝕，氣動效率下降並需要高空修補；超速保護失效則可能導致葉片飛脫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excessive tip speed lets rain and ice strip the leading-edge coating within a few years, lowering aerodynamic efficiency and requiring rope-access repair; failure of overspeed protection can throw a blade. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以主軸編碼器量測轉速，並在額定運轉點核對轉速、功率與由此推得的主軸轉矩是否落在傳動鏈設計包絡內。
knowledge.textEn: Measure speed with the main-shaft encoder and check that speed, power and the implied main-shaft torque at rated operation lie within the drivetrain design envelope.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 前緣保護系統的選型要以場址降雨與葉尖速做沖蝕壽命評估，並把檢查與補修窗口排入年度維護。
knowledge.textEn: Select leading-edge protection from an erosion-life assessment using site rainfall and tip speed, and schedule inspection and repair windows in annual maintenance.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61400-3 離岸風力機設計要求。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61400-3 Design requirements for fixed and floating offshore wind turbines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「葉尖速與轉速」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tip speed and rotor speed" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
發電機的功率只跟它的體積有關，跟形狀無關。
葉尖速過高時雨滴與冰晶撞擊使前緣塗層在數年內剝蝕，氣動效率下降並需要高空修補；超速保護失效則可能導致葉片飛脫。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A generator's power depends only on its volume, not its shape.
Excessive tip speed lets rain and ice strip the leading-edge coating within a few years, lowering aerodynamic efficiency and requiring rope-access repair.
quiz.explanation: 葉尖速過高時雨滴與冰晶撞擊使前緣塗層在數年內剝蝕，氣動效率下降並需要高空修補；超速保護失效則可能導致葉片飛脫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excessive tip speed lets rain and ice strip the leading-edge coating within a few years, lowering aerodynamic efficiency and requiring rope-access repair; failure of overspeed protection can throw a blade. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 葉尖速與轉速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tip speed and rotor speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「葉尖速與轉速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Tip speed and rotor speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 葉尖速過高時雨滴與冰晶撞擊使前緣塗層在數年內剝蝕，氣動效率下降並需要高空修補；超速保護失效則可能導致葉片飛脫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「直驅永磁風力發電機」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Excessive tip speed lets rain and ice strip the leading-edge coating within a few years, lowering aerodynamic efficiency and requiring rope-access repair; failure of overspeed protection can throw a blade. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generators”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低轉速意味著發電機要嘛做成直徑很大的多極直驅式，要嘛經齒輪箱增速；轉矩等於功率除以角速度，也隨葉輪加大而快速上升。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Low speed means the generator is either a large-diameter multi-pole direct drive or is geared up; torque, power over angular speed, also rises rapidly with rotor size.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大型風機的葉片轉得很慢，所以葉尖的速度也很慢。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The blades of a large turbine turn slowly, so the tips move slowly too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 葉尖速過高時雨滴與冰晶撞擊使前緣塗層在數年內剝蝕，氣動效率下降並需要高空修補；超速保護失效則可能導致葉片飛脫。
knowledge.textEn: Excessive tip speed lets rain and ice strip the leading-edge coating within a few years, lowering aerodynamic efficiency and requiring rope-access repair; failure of overspeed protection can throw a blade.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
